## Subsystem
Which crate or game system does this affect? (e.g., `vehicles`, `missions`, `renderer`, `gta_formats`)

## Description
Describe the missing original GTA: San Andreas feature or technical improvement.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Compiles on Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64
- [ ] Integrated with relevant gameplay/engine systems
- [ ] Automated tests added
- [ ] `DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.md` and `FEATURE_MATRIX.md` updated
